assertions.name: a release declaring new network egress is refused before any signature is considered
a release declaring a model runtime is refused before any signature is considered
a release declaring an authority that does not exist in this contract is refused before any signature is considered
a release declaring an audience other than a customer installation is refused before any signature is considered
a release published before it was built is refused
importing a release needs its own authority, not merely read access
a release from an untrusted signer is refused
